| Not Available in HTML | It means this is not present in the HTML mock. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

| Only in HTML | This is not available in the Shahi menu but available in the HTML. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Method and limits |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Every menu, sub-menu and level in the Excel was compared with every node in the HTML menu data. Items were matched by meaning because the HTML has renamed and re-organised many menus (for example Buyer to Customer, Production to Manufacturing, QC to Quality). |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
